statement: After the U013 challenge, the idea's distinctiveness rests almost entirely on the training-time application of mechanisms that are individually established prior art: same-passage provenance maps to text-graph/KG construction from text (C017, C016), the repair loop maps to process-supervision self-bootstrapping (C018, C019), and the effective ingredient is the reasoning chain, i.e., established path supervision (C015). Component-level overlap with prior work is therefore substantial, even though the exact training-time combination was not found.
